cases.finding: Current control finishes landscaping using questions22–24. A detour after three unknown business responsibilities shifts landscaping to question24 with only its first specific check completed.

cases.finding: Current control confirms the second bookkeeping check at24. The hybrid inserts an unfamiliar services activity at10; its bookkeeping second check is not reached.
cases.interpretation: Known bookkeeping interest did not disappear. This is a budget/selection loss.

cases.interpretation: A broad affirmative activity can still trigger expensive branching; preserving only direct item anchors does not preserve every useful starting field.
